camel_example: aliyun agentidentity UpdateIdentityProvider --region cn-hangzhou --Description 'example identity provider' --DiscoveryURL 'https://oauth.aliyun.com/.well-known/openid-configuration' --AllowedAudience '["client-1"]' --IdentityProviderName 'identity-provider-okta' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_zh: 更新指定的身份提供商
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity update-identity-provider --identity-provider-name identity-provider-okta --discovery-url https://oauth.aliyun.com/.well-known/openid-configuration --allowed-audience client-1 --description 'example identity provider' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of the identity provider
parameters.name: identity_provider_name

parameters.help_en: The metadata URL used to retrieve the OpenID configuration or authorization server metadata
parameters.help_zh: 元数据地址。用于获取 OpenID 配置或者授权服务器元数据
parameters.name: discovery_url

parameters.help_en: The allowed audiences. A token is allowed if its aud claim contains any of the specified audiences
parameters.help_zh: 允许的受众，签发的 Token 任一包含其中的 aud，即表示允许
parameters.name: allowed_audience
